name: pondy-promoters-workspace
description: Unified build for Pondy Promoters Web and Admin

scripts.install:all: cd PPWeb && npm install && cd ../PPAdmin && npm install
scripts.build: npm run install:all && npm run build:web && npm run build:admin && rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp -R PPWeb/dist/* dist/ && mkdir -p dist/admin && cp -R PPAdmin/dist/* dist/admin/
